description: Estimate apportioned (IRP) registration fees from your miles by jurisdiction and each jurisdiction's full-year fee. Use this tested BusCalc worksheet when the task matches its inputs and scope. Returns named results, units, formula, assumptions, method version, reference-value notes (official figure or your figure, with source and effective date), a check link and a source-page URL. Official reference values are prefilled when omitted; supply every other figure from the user's records. Percent fields take percent numbers. No figures are looked up; no private projects or purchases are accessed. Put tool fields inside inputs. Supply units or modelVersion only when listed in inputSchema. Follow its required fields and exact choices. Do not pass the REST calculator field inside MCP arguments.

jurisdictions.description: IRP jurisdictions and fees. Use matching records or an explicitly identified assumption for irp jurisdictions and fees. Unknown is not the same as zero.

fullFee.description: Full-year registration fee in this jurisdiction (your figure) (US dollars). The fee the jurisdiction would charge for your weight and axle configuration if all miles were there.

label.description: Jurisdiction or reference label (no names needed). Use matching records or an explicitly identified assumption for jurisdiction or reference label (no names needed). Unknown is not the same as zero. Optional reference label; no names or personal data.

miles.description: Fleet miles in this jurisdiction (mi). Actual miles in the reporting period, or estimated miles for a new account.

otherMiles.description: Miles in places with no IRP fee row (other countries, non-IRP areas) (mi). These raise total miles but add no fee.

vehicles.description: Power units on the account (vehicles). Enter 1 if the fees above are already for the whole fleet.

modelVersion.description: Optional expected method version; a mismatch is rejected.

name: buscalc_irp_apportioned_registration_fee_estimate

checkURL.description: Link that replays this calculation on https://buscalc.com/sumtru/verify/. Null when the inputs hold free-form text or the link would be too long.

notes.description: Reference-value notes first, then model notes and the standard limit statement.

referenceValues.description: One entry per official reference value in play: the official figure, the figure used, status official or user, source, effective date and the note text.

sealURL.description: Where a saved record of this result can be sealed with an independent timestamp.

title: IRP apportioned registration fee estimate
